title: TangentPDE: Learning Local Operator Responses with Sparse Finite-Difference Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2611.24873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural PDE operators are often optimized through state reconstruction, which largely constrains operator values at observed inputs but does not fully characterize their sensitivity to local perturbations. A more faithful approximation of operator behavior requires not only accurate state predictions, but also correct variations along local perturbation directions. We present TangentPDE, which uses finite differences to approximate directional derivatives and constructs task-relevant finite-step responses from the state outputs of a reference solver at sparse paired inputs. Its objective jointly constrains state fidelity, response-direction alignment, and response-magnitude calibration, thereby learning both operator values and their local variations. Because the response labels are constructed solely from state outputs at paired inputs, the method requires neither explicit derivative labels, linearized or adjoint PDE solves, nor full Jac

translated_title: TangentPDE：利用稀疏有限差分监督学习局部算子响应
translated_abstract: 神经PDE算子通常通过状态重构进行优化，这在很大程度上仅约束了算子在观测输入处的取值，却未能充分刻画其对局部扰动的敏感性。要更忠实地逼近算子行为，不仅需要准确的状态预测，还需要沿局部扰动方向的正确变化。我们提出TangentPDE，该方法利用有限差分近似方向导数，并基于参考求解器在稀疏成对输入处的状态输出来构建与任务相关的有限步长响应。其目标函数共同约束状态保真度、响应方向对齐以及响应幅值校准，从而同时学习算子的取值及其局部变化。由于响应标签仅由成对输入处的状态输出构建，该方法既不需要显式的导数标签，也不需要线性化或伴随PDE求解，更不需要完整的雅可比矩阵。
tldr: 提出TangentPDE方法，仅利用参考求解器在稀疏成对输入处的状态输出构造有限差分响应监督，无需导数标签、伴随求解或完整雅可比矩阵，即可同时学习神经PDE算子的取值及其局部变化。
en_tdlr: TangentPDE learns both neural PDE operator values and their local variations using sparse finite-difference supervision built solely from paired state outputs, requiring no derivative labels, adjoint solves, or full Jacobians.
